title: VIXEN WSL configure requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT injection for glyph capture builds
body: The queued baseline command 'cmake -S /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/glyphleak/VIXEN --preset vixen-wsl -DVIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF && /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/glyphleak/build-wsl.sh --target vixen_lookdev_capture -j4' failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset. Re-running the same queued command under 'env UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/pair-hlsl' configured and built successfully. The consumer/provider root should be resolved by the tracked build facade or launcher so captures do not require lane-specific environment wiring.

title: Merged glyph codegen job retained retired per-file output variables
body: The queued local-kernel regeneration failed because VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt invoked --out-cpp-dir/--out-glsl-dir/--out-layout-hash-dir with empty values: merge resolution preserved the new multi-type job but the old per-file path setup and redundant path_instance target. Aligning both platform branches to the directory variables and removing the obsolete duplicate PathInstance job made glyph_outline_instance_regen pass. The codegen job contract and its path preparation should be one declarative unit so merge evolution cannot split them.
